summary: First full test after MVP build for Sudarshan Karweer thought-leadership platform. Executed 25 pytest backend tests (all pass) covering meta, articles listing + filters (news/analysis/blog/rd/casestudy) + slug fetch + 404, auth (register/login/me/duplicate/no-token/role-forbidden), consultation create + admin list + PATCH status update, admin stats, article CRUD by admin + 403 for client, AI SSE streaming chat and AI generate (admin-only). Executed Playwright E2E flow via external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: home renders (hero, consultation, AI widget), consultation submit shows success toast and persists, AI widget streamed a real Claude Sonnet 4.6 response, /insights lists 12 seeded articles and article detail loads, /admin and /dashboard redirect unauth users to /login, /register creates client and lands on /dashboard, client visiting /admin is redirected to /dashboard, admin login lands on /admin, Leads tab lists submissions and status change persists (PATCH ok), Create+AI tab: AI generate populated a real draft, publish created the article and it appeared in Articles tab, delete removed it. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses JWT via Authorization Bearer header only, but backend also accepts httpOnly cookie 'access_token' in get_current_user — cookie is never set (login returns token in body). This is consistent with the frontend approach but worth noting; if the product roadmap includes cookie-based auth, add Set-Cookie in login/register.
CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True and defaults to '*' via env fallback; combining '*' with credentials is invalid per spec. Ensure CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit origins in production.

Article slug uniqueness relies on a random 6-char suffix appended to slugified title; unique index on 'slug' exists but there is no retry on IntegrityError. Very low probability collision but worth handling.
PATCH /api/consultations/{cid} accepts status as a query parameter without validating the enum (any string accepted). Consider Pydantic Literal validation.

No rate-limiting or brute-force protection on /api/auth/login. Auth playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails — not implemented (only Bearer JWT, no cookies, no lockout). Flag as future hardening if playbook compliance is required.
seed articles are inserted only when collection is empty; changes to seed_data.py after first startup will NOT propagate. Consider upsert-by-slug for content updates.
test_credentials: Admin sudarshan@karweers.com / Sudarshan@2026 (seeded, verified). Client registered dynamically during test.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 consultation lead (TEST UI Lead) via UI and 1 client user (test_ui_<ts>@example.com). Created + deleted 1 AI-generated article. Backend test suite also created transient TEST_ users, consultations and articles (deletions performed inline).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows work end-to-end. Backend uses uuid string ids (no ObjectId leak, all endpoints exclude _id). AI SSE streaming works. Admin seeded on startup, and admin password self-heals if it drifts. To avoid Playwright timing issues when reading admin overview stats, wait ~1500ms after selector visible for the async /admin/stats fetch to resolve. Playbook auth features NOT implemented (no httpOnly cookies set, no lockout) — Bearer-only via localStorage 'sk_token' — this is by design of the current build.
